Subject: Request: inspection scope and subprocessors evidence for onboarding

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor onboarding and internal audit, LegalOps has asked for a concise package covering:
- complete list of subprocessors and where data is processed
- DPIA summary and where article 28/30 obligations are satisfied
- sample evidence for audit (access logs, retention configs, SOC2 cover sheet)

I've attached our questionnaire (eurobank_questionnaire_v2.pdf) — can you confirm what we can provide within two weeks? Also would appreciate a short playbook for auditors describing how to request additional logs or copies (point people, expected SLAs).

We may run a light inspection with our external auditors (Tom Haines from AuditFirm) in late April; can you confirm availability for a 45-minute kickoff?

Best,
Marta
Marta Garcia
Vendor Governance — EuroBank

Thanks Ava — quick technical notes to shape the auditor playbook and evidence deliverables. Cutting to the practical:

1) Logs and exports we can produce quickly (format and examples will match EuroBank's questionnaire if you send field list):
   - Auth & access logs (last 90 days) — can provide CSV slices (timestamp, user_id, token_id, action, resource)
   - Model inference metadata (non-PII) — request IDs, model version, region, request/response timestamps
   - Key management pointers (KMS provider + envelope policy) — redacted keys only

2) Retention evidence:
   - Policy snapshot + sample retention enforcement job results for object lifecycle (S3/GCS)
   - Data-at-rest mapping that shows which stores contain customer data and their retention config

3) Art.30 / processing ledger export:
   - We can generate a CSV extract with processing activity summary for EuroBank (purpose, categories of data, recipients/subprocessors, legal basis) — this satisfies many auditors' checklist items.

4) Scoped remote session: for auditors who need interactive queries, we should limit to: read-only analyst role, timeboxed (90m), and recorded session with an Ops engineer mediating.

Action items for Laura/Neha: if LegalOps wants signed attestations about processing roles we should prepare a one-page attestation template (Laura). Neha — can you map the few EuroBank use-cases to our processing ledger so we can pre-populate the Art.30 extract?

I'll prepare the log sample exports and a short ops playbook for the remote session today.

— Karthik
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
